name: MiniMax Speech 2.8 Turbo
access: MiniMax Audio API: synchronous HTTP POST /v1/t2a_v2, WebSocket and bidirectional WebSocket, model speech-2.8-turbo; asynchronous long-text jobs

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text, with optional pause markers, inline pronunciation, and interjection tags in parentheses
voice.output_audio: mp3, pcm, flac, wav, pcmu_raw, pcmu_wav (G.711 mu-law, 8 kHz) and opus; sample rates 8000, 16000, 22050, 24000, 32000 and 44100 Hz; mono or stereo; MP3 bitrates 32, 64, 128 and 256 kbps; non-streaming output as hex or as a URL valid for 24 hours [mm-t2a-http]
voice.voices: a list of system voices, rapid voice cloning from a sample of 10 seconds to 5 minutes (a clone unused for 7 days is deleted), and voice design from a text description [mm-t2a-http] [mm-voice-clone] [mm-voice-design] [mm-news-28]
voice.session_limit: 10,000 characters per synchronous request, and streaming is advised above 3,000 characters; asynchronous jobs take up to 1M characters [mm-t2a-http] [mm-async]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, not per token. Pay-as-you-go list price US$60 per 1M characters for the synchronous and the asynchronous endpoints [mm-paygo]. Voice design costs US$3 per voice and rapid voice cloning US$1.5 per voice, each charged at first use in synthesis. The pricing page gives US$60 per 1M characters for voice-design preview audio, while the voice design API reference gives US$30 [mm-paygo] [mm-voice-design]. Artificial Analysis lists US$60 per 1M characters [aa-tts-board]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Elo (text-to-speech leaderboard)
benchmarks.setting: blind pairwise listener votes; the quality Elo in the leaderboard data of the page, read on 2026-10-04
